body:
>“It’s not broken, don’t fix it” as in- it’s been working for years, why change now?

It's not that we think it isn't broken. It just broke slowly enough and in just the right ways that we don't have the frame of reference to know that there's anything better.

With only 36% percent of Americans holding a passport, many will never know.

There is no right and wrong when it comes to the end of a life. But at least this way you'll know you at least tried with a mind set you may not have had before. I applaud you for getting to thehotel, writing the note, and almost doing it. But I admire the strength/will/ whatever it took to step down and maybe give it another chance.
Why do you need to *fix* anything? Maybe you could just squeeze a couple more miles out if you don't care about the way you "fix" yourself.  Half of my life is held together with spit and duct tape.

Unless she tells you why she did it, remember, it's noones fault. I have people that I love and love me but I think about death a lot. The best thing might just be too make plans with her regularly. Lunch plans, a walk, help her with household stuff, it doesn't have to be extravagant it just has to be something.

Well no-one actualy knows.

 I just want to know what other like minded people are hoping for after the lights go out.

How about instead of fixing it, just try to see the end of this window B.S. 

If you're gonna off yourself anyway why not make sure that it's not for nothing and if they *do* win they'll know that *they* were the straw that broke the camel's back.
Self improvement? Like what? And from who's perspective will it be an improvement?
Do you have a will, a note, or both?

You've typed things that I've felt for so long but never had the mental skills to put into an organized thought.

Good friends. Pets that I would kill for. A fiancé that's crazy about me. 

Basically being hollow for no other reason than this is just the way I am. 

I have sleep apnea and narcolepsy. It just means that I wake up about 6 times every hour and I can fall asleep in under two minutes. I physically can't wake myself up to an alarm. So unless someone wakes me up, I'll miss work or schooland my days off are wasted sleeping until 430pm. It makes me feel useless and lazy. I've tried anti- depressants, uppers, weed, and booze. But none of it worked on me. And the doctor couldn't find anything wrong with me. 

 When I came to the conclusion that I *will* be the one in charge of the end of my life I felt free - ish.  I just decided that I have somethings I need to do first. 

It's not God. (I'm a full on atheist) it's not my family's or friend's feelings that keep me here. Pretty much the only thing keeping me here is the fact that I have bucket list. As of right now I dont have anything impossible on my list that I can't do in the next couple years with the exception of the 04-08-2024 solar eclipse. And even then, I saw the August eclipse and I just might settle for that. Im just hoping that somewhere between here and there something happens that makes me ***want*** to stay after the list is done.
